cohort: The study included 92 young women of childbearing age with cervical high-grade squamous intraepithelial lesions (HSIL), 46 of whom were treated with HIFU and 46 with LEEP.
finding: The study found no significant difference in adverse pregnancy outcomes, including preterm birth and premature rupture of membranes, between patients treated with HIFU and those treated with LEEP.
